description: Drought declarations - Queensland is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Primary Industries. This dataset shows whether Local Government Areas (LGAs) in Queensland are fully, partly or not drought-declared. Drought declarations are made by the Minister for Primary Industries based on the advice of Local Drought Committees (LDCs). Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Primary Industries. It offers 4 resource(s) in rest, shp, tab, fgdb, kmz, gpkg, wms, xml. The portal shows 2026-08-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Transitional, do not use - Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
